text:
Priority: low
Parked: make the reader's forecasts change decisions, or stop asking for the odds

Found on 2026-10-31, parked by Sri behind speed work. The reader commits forecasts of cost, time and odds of success before each job (reading.rs). Only one thing acts on them: a reading forecast to run past the producer's or verifier's time limit is refused. Nothing else reads them. The odds score Brier 0.083, worse than the 0.063 reference built from past success rates, and time misses widely (hydf: 30 min forecast, 1h23m actual).

BRIEF.md A2 and spec requirement OLY-B-A2-03 ask that mispredictions update the defaults, the estimates and the routing, and the brief judges the experiment on calibration improving over time. Request 20261030-024659-qkzw (give OLY-B-A2-03 a mechanism) is the queued work for this.

Options when this is picked up: use the forecasts (for example, skip planning when the odds are high, order likely wins first, or replace the reader's odds with the reference when the reference scores better), or stop asking the reader for odds and keep only the time forecast the guard needs.
